Embrey House KitchenHancockBad hero. Good sandwich.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersBeach whale prawnsGarlic chilli prawns. Walter the whale took out a sailboat.How to make it600g green prawns4 garlic cloves, crushed2 red chillies, chopped3 limes60g butter, meltedToss the prawns with garlic, chopped red chillies, lime zest and melted butter.Grill for a couple of minutes a side until charred.Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan.All Heart bruschettaToasted baguette rubbed with garlic, topped with tomato and basilHow to make it1 baguette4 ripe tomatoes, diced2 garlic cloves1/4 cup basil leaves, torn2 tbsp olive oil1/2 tsp saltSlice the baguette and toast the slices.Mix the tomatoes with one crushed garlic clove, basil, olive oil and salt.Rub the toasts with the cut garlic clove and pile the tomato on just before serving.Prison yard toasted cheese and pickleJail watch, day five: good job.How to make itAs written, serves 4Sharp cheddar and tangy pickle toasted in buttered bread until golden and oozing, cut into squares and lined up on a canteen tray.Butter one side of 8 slices of bread.Lay 4 slices butter side down and spread each with 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish.Top with 200g grated vintage cheddar, then the remaining bread, butter side up.Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted.Cut each into 4 squares and line them up on a tray.MainsPR makeover steakGrilled sirloin in a cracked pepper cream sauce, thick chipsHow to make it1kg potatoes1 L vegetable oil for frying4 sirloin steaks1 tbsp cracked peppercorns200ml cream100g mixed salad leavesCut the potatoes into thick chips.Fry twice in the oil until crisp.Grill the steaks to medium-rare and rest.In the pan, toast the peppercorns, add the cream and simmer until thick.Serve with the chips and a green salad.Ray's family spaghetti and meatballsSpaghetti madness, brought to the prison.How to make itAs written, serves 4Parmesan beef meatballs simmered in a slow tomato and basil sauce over spaghetti, with crisp garlic bread and a green salad.Mix 600g beef mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan, 1 egg, parsley and salt and roll 20 meatballs.Brown in olive oil.Soften 3 garlic cloves and 1 onion, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and basil, simmer 20 minutes, then add the meatballs for 20 minutes more.Split a baguette, spread with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.Cook 500g spaghetti and serve with salad leaves.SweetsRay's All-Heart browniesFudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into squaresHow to make it200g dark chocolate150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs100g plain flour4 scoops of vanilla ice creamMelt the chocolate with the butter.Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour.Bake in a lined tin at 170°C.Cool slightly, cut into squares and serve warm with ice cream. Good job.DrinksHancock's whisky sourWhisky, lemon juice, sugar syrup and egg white shakenHow to make it200ml whisky4 lemons60ml sugar syrup2 egg whites3 dashes of bitters1 bag iceFor each drink, measure 50ml whisky, the juice of 1 lemon, 15ml sugar syrup, 1 egg white and 1 dash bitters into a shaker.Shake each drink without ice for 10 seconds.Add ice and shake again, then strain into a short glass over fresh ice.Shake drops of bitters onto the foam. For the sober version, make iced tea with lemon and honey.
